senses.sense_definition: The legal process by which a lender takes possession of a mortgaged property when the borrower fails to make payments.

examples.text: The family faced <w>foreclosure</w> after losing both of their steady incomes.
Many homes were sold at auction following the wave of <w>foreclosures</w> during the financial crisis.

senses.sense_definition: In psychoanalysis, the radical exclusion or repudiation of a fundamental signifier, seen as a primary mechanism underlying psychosis.

examples.text: The seminar examined the concept of <w>foreclosure</w> in early childhood development.
In psychoanalytic theory, <w>foreclosure</w> explains the onset of certain severe psychological conditions.
